name: @agents-js/example-host-memory-pilot
description: Host-side consumer pilot for @agents-js/memory + @agents-js/memory-local. Demonstrates the consumption pattern a host runtime uses to compose LocalMemoryProvider, exercises all three MemoryActor.kind variants (agent | human | service), and re-runs runProviderConformanceTests against the host-composed provider so the contract pin survives host wrapping.
